definitions.explanation: Items used in daily life, such as toiletries, cleaning supplies, and household basics.

examples.japanese: {日用品|にちようひん}を{買|か}いに{行|い}く。
{日用品|にちようひん}{売|う}り{場|ば}はどこですか。
examples.english: Where is the daily necessities section?

examples.japanese: ドラッグストアで{日用品|にちようひん}と{食品|しょくひん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought daily necessities and food at the drugstore.

notes:
COMMON ITEMS:
- {洗剤|せんざい}: detergent
- {石鹸|せっけん}: soap
- {歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ}: toothpaste
- {トイレットペーパー: toilet paper
- ティッシュ: tissues

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日用品|にちようひん}{売|う}り{場|ば}: daily necessities section
- {日用品|にちようひん}を{揃|そろ}える: to stock up on daily necessities

RELATED:
- {消耗品|しょうもうひん}: consumables
- {生活|せいかつ}{用品|ようひん}: household goods
